turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling. How can I help today?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I would like the order delivered to my home address.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Noted, delivery to your home address.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It has been unusually warm this week, hasn't it?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: It certainly has. Anything else I can help with?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: One more thing, I prefer the dark display mode in the app.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Also please keep on file that I am allergic to peanuts.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Recorded. I will make sure that stays on your file.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please change the delivery to my office from now on. Nobody is home during the day.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: And I still like the darker screen setting, keep that as it is.
